notes: GEO ACCESSION: GSE238242, 10x multiome (paired snATAC + snRNA), 14 libraries, left atrial appendage, persistent AF vs sinus rhythm. VERIFIED DESIGN: 14 GSMs = 7 snRNA + 7 snATAC; the snRNA arm is 4 SR / 3 persistent-AF donors (CF69, CF77, CF89, CF91 / CF93, CF97, CF102). Only the snRNA arm is fetched (~45 MB of the 187 MB RAW.tar; the ~130 MB ATAC arm is not downloaded). The author cell table GSE238242_snAF.metadata.tsv.gz carries one row per nucleus with cell_type/sample/sex/Rhythm; the author label cell_type == 'CM' gates 3,049 of 11,986 nuclei and the per-donor sum of raw counts is the pseudobulk (reproduced cell-for-cell against the pre-existing audit's cm_pseudobulk_counts.tsv, max abs diff 0). The annotation is a flat author table whose clustering is not in the deposit (no Seurat/ArchR object or h5ad), so the labels can be trusted but not re-derived; recorded. MEASURED v2 DEGs: 0 (no gene at padj<0.05; minimum padj 0.231; 0 at padj<0.10) - the honest null for 3 vs 4 donors, published rather than loosened. FILTER VARIANT SENSITIVITY (pre-existing audit): CPM>=1 in >=3/7, >=7/7 and trend=TRUE all give 0 at padj<0.05. BUILD: capped 10 GiB RLIMIT_AS, OMP_NUM_THREADS=2; pseudobulk peak RSS 2,474 MB, wall 14 s; DEG peak RSS 137 MB, wall 1 s. REPRODUCTION: script/fetch.sh -> script/verify.sh -> script/build_pseudobulk.py -> script/build_deg.py; a second build is byte-identical.
purpose: Human left-atrial-appendage 10x multiome snRNA source for the Stage 2 gene axis under ADR 0071: author CM label, per-donor CM count pseudobulk, persistent AF vs sinus rhythm. Tier-1 AF source; the expected and measured v2 DEG count is zero.

sources.method: script/fetch.sh (curl from the GEO series matrix/ and suppl/ directories and from GEO's per-sample supplementary directories): the series matrix, the author cell table and the seven snRNA count tables, byte-identical to the GSE238242_RAW.tar members. The ~130 MB snATAC arm is not fetched.
